description: Na₃CrBPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.68 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.07 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.34 Å) and two longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-46°. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one Cr, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cr, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one P atom.
